description: Conflict priority, compliance scoring weights and graph interpretation parameters.

payload.rationale: When design operators compete for one parameter the higher category wins: composition > spatial > lighting > material.
Relative weight of each rule category in the grammar compliance score; sums to 1.

rules.title: SOLID_VOID relation: interpretation parameters of the interlock magnitude

payload.subject: GRAPH_SOLID_VOID
payload.rationale: Interlock magnitude = ratio_fit * ((1 - integrity_weight) + void_integrity * integrity_weight). ratio_fit: triangular fit of the measured negative-space share, peak at optimal_ratio, zero at optimal_ratio +/- ratio_spread. void_integrity = largest void share * max(0, 1 - components / component_limit). The share is the pixel estimator (lower bound of void_ratio, ADR-0001 sec. 1): optimal_ratio is NOT a void_ratio target; period bands live in CAS-VS.
